metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 healthy adults (14 females) using a 62-channel g.tec g.HIamp system at a sampling rate of 600 Hz, with online bandpass filtering (0.1-100 Hz) and a 48-52 Hz notch filter. Electrodes were arranged according to the International 10-20 system, referenced to the right earlobe. Stimuli were presented and behavioral responses collected using E-Prime 3.0. Participants performed two Morse code-based auditory discrimination tasks (dot-count and first-last match) under three presentation-rate conditions. Data are organized in BIDS format with raw BrainVision files and minimally preprocessed derivatives, including interpolation of corrupted channels for select participants.
